name: Elsie Fitzgerald
source:
Elsie is [url=/c148372]Fame[/url]’s mother. Your typical teenage runaway who ran into the arms of a low-level junkie biker who was never going anywhere in the world and took it out on her. She met [url=/c148416]Blaine’s father[/url] at a shoot for Sin Parade after being fired from her job and in desperate need of money.

[In game description]
